content.content:
# Direction A: Longitudinal 3D Medical Imaging FM — Literature Review

**Scope.** A 3D medical imaging foundation model (FM) that natively ingests a SEQUENCE of patient-aligned 3D volumes (CT/MRI), with variable time intervals, optionally paired with longitudinal reports and EHR events, trained with temporal self-supervised objectives (interval-aware masked volume modeling, next-volume prediction in latent space, cross-modal temporal contrast). Downstream targets: disease progression, treatment response (RECIST), recurrence forecasting, longitudinal report generation.

**Date of review:** 2026-05-13.
**Coverage:** ~75 papers across 12 sections, organized to expose the white space at the intersection of (a) native 3D FM, (b) variable-interval temporal SSL, and (c) multimodal longitudinal context.

---

## 1. Foundation Models for 3D Medical Imaging (single-timepoint baseline)

This section catalogues the SOTA single-scan 3D medical FMs that any longitudinal 3D FM must outperform on standard tasks while additionally handling time.

### 1.1 Merlin — Stanford CCSL
- **Title:** Merlin: A Vision-Language Foundation Model for 3D Computed Tomography
- **Lead author / year / venue:** Louis Blankemeier, 2024, arXiv:2406.06512 (later expanded version 2026)
- **Description.** A 3D CT VLM trained on 15,331 abdominal CTs with 6M+ paired report tokens and 1.8M+ structured EHR codes (ICD/CPT).
- **What they did.** Dual supervision from (a) radiology reports (contrastive) and (b) EHR diagnosis codes (multi-label phenotype prediction). Evaluated on 752 tasks: 30 zero-shot findings, 692 phenotypes, 6-disease 5-year risk, retrieval, report gen, 20-organ segmentation.
- **Gap vs. full longitudinal 3D FM.** Strictly single-CT input. The "5-year risk" is supervision from future EHR labels only — no future imaging modeling. No sequence input, no interval-aware objective, no next-volume prediction.

### 1.2 CT-CLIP / CT-RATE
- **Title:** Developing Generalist Foundation Models from a Multimodal Dataset for 3D Computed Tomography
- **Lead author / year / venue:** Ibrahim Ethem Hamamci, 2024, arXiv:2403.17834, published Nature Biomedical Engineering 2025
- **Description.** First public 3D CT-text dataset (CT-RATE: 25,692 non-contrast chest CTs / 50,188 reconstructions / 21,304 patients) and CLIP-style 3D model.
- **What they did.** ViT (CT-ViT) image encoder + text transformer; contrastive image-report alignment; zero-shot abnormality detection across 18 labels; case retrieval.
- **Gap.** Single-volume only. No temporal awareness. CT-RATE itself contains repeated patients but the model ignores intra-patient sequence.

### 1.3 CT-FM — DFCI/Mass General Brigham
- **Title:** Vision Foundation Models for Computed Tomography
- **Lead author / year / venue:** Suraj Pai et al., 2025, arXiv:2501.09001
- **Description.** A 3D CT FM pre-trained with label-agnostic contrastive learning on 148,000 CTs from Imaging Data Commons.
- **What they did.** Evaluated across whole-body and tumor segmentation, head-CT triage, image retrieval, semantic clustering; strong test-retest stability.
- **Gap.** Single-volume FM. No paired text, no longitudinal modeling.

### 1.4 RadFM
- **Title:** Towards Generalist Foundation Model for Radiology by Leveraging Web-scale 2D&3D Medical Data
- **Lead author / year / venue:** Chaoyi Wu, Weidi Xie et al., 2024 (arXiv:2308.02463); Nature Communications 2025
- **Description.** Multimodal generalist over X-ray/CT/MRI/PET with 13M 2D and 615K 3D scans + paired text (MedMD).
- **What they did.** Single arch ingests 2D or 3D + text; outputs free-text diagnoses, VQA, reports. Benchmarked via RadBench.
- **Gap.** Single-study input. No native sequence modeling; multi-image input is concatenation of unrelated studies, not patient time series.

### 1.5 M3FM
- **Title:** Medical multimodal multitask foundation model for lung cancer screening
- **Lead author / year / venue:** Chuang Niu, 2025, Nat Commun s41467-025-56822-w
- **Description.** Foundation model for low-dose chest CT screening trained on 49 clinical data types, 163,725 CT series, 17 LCS tasks.
- **What they did.** CT-ViT + Text Transformer + Task Encoder. Improves lung cancer risk and CV mortality prediction by up to 20% / 10%.
- **Gap.** While NLST data is longitudinal, M3FM treats each scan as a single-study + tabular input. No temporal SSL; the longitudinal structure of NLST screening intervals is not exploited at pretraining.

### 1.6 SuPreM
- **Title:** Supervised Pre-Trained 3D Models for Medical Image Analysis
- **Lead author / year / venue:** Wenxuan Li et al., ICLR 2024 oral
- **Description.** Suite of 3D models supervised-pretrained on AbdomenAtlas 1.1 (9,262 CT volumes, 25 organs, 7 pseudo-tumor classes); AbdomenAtlas 1.0 v3 has 20,460 CT volumes.
- **Gap.** Supervised on segmentation; no temporal awareness; no longitudinal data used.

### 1.7 VoCo
- **Title:** A Simple-yet-Effective Volume Contrastive Learning Framework for 3D Medical Image Analysis
- **Lead author / year / venue:** Linshan Wu, CVPR 2024, arXiv:2402.17300 (TPAMI 2025 extension "Geometric Context Priors")
- **Description.** Self-supervised pretraining that contrasts sub-volume crops against base-crop anchors using positional/geometric priors.
- **Gap.** Within-volume positional contrast only. No inter-scan / inter-time contrast.

### 1.8 3DINO / 3DINO-ViT
- **Title:** A generalizable 3D framework and model for self-supervised learning in medical imaging
- **Lead author / year / venue:** Pohl group + collaborators, npj Digital Medicine 2025 (s41746-025-02035-w)
- **Description.** Memory-efficient adaptation of DINOv2 to 3D, pretrained on ~100K scans (70K MRI + 27.8K CT + 566 PET) across 10+ organs.
- **What they did.** Image-level + patch-level self-distillation with 2 global + 8 local crops; releases weights.
- **Gap.** Single-volume self-distillation only; no temporal pair / sequence handling.

### 1.9 BrainIAC
- **Title:** A generalizable foundation model for analysis of human brain MRI
- **Lead author / year / venue:** Kann lab (AIM-KannLab), Nature Neuroscience 2026 (s41593-026-02202-6)
- **Description.** Brain MRI FM trained SSL on 48,519 brain MRIs.
- **What they did.** Demonstrates brain age, dementia, time-to-stroke, brain-cancer outcomes; multi-task downstream evaluation.
- **Gap.** SSL is single-scan; downstream temporal tasks use FM as feature extractor and a separate head — no longitudinal pretraining objective.

### 1.10 MedSAM / MedSAM2 / SAM-Med3D
- **Titles:** Segment Anything in Medical Images (Bo Wang, Nat Commun 2024); MedSAM2 (arXiv:2504.03600); SAM-Med3D
- **Description.** Promptable segmentation FMs. MedSAM2 fine-tunes SAM2.1 for both 3D images and temporal video with a memory-attention module.
- **Gap vs. Direction A.** Segmentation-focused; MedSAM2 has memory-attention across slices/frames but does not handle interval-spaced visits / cross-modal temporal context. Not designed for outcome prediction.

### 1.11 Aerts cancer-imaging FM
- **Title:** Foundation model for cancer imaging biomarkers
- **Lead author / year / venue:** Suraj Pai, Hugo Aerts et al., Nature Machine Intelligence 6: 354–367, 2024
- **Description.** SSL convolutional encoder on 11,467 radiographic lesions; predicts anatomical site, malignancy, prognosis.
- **Gap.** Lesion-patch level, not whole-volume; single-time-point only; precursor to CT-FM.

### 1.12 BTB3D
- **Title:** Better Tokens for Better 3D: Advancing Vision-Language Modeling in 3D Medical Imaging
- **Lead author / year / venue:** 2025, arXiv:2510.20639
- **Description.** Causal conv encoder-decoder unifying 2D/3D into compact frequency-aware volumetric tokens. SOTA on text-to-CT synthesis (FID −75%, FVD halved) and report-gen (+40% clinical F1 over Merlin/CT-CHAT).
- **Gap.** Tokenizer + decoder for single CT; no temporal sequence modeling.

### 1.13 Triad
- **Title:** Triad: Vision Foundation Model for 3D Magnetic Resonance Imaging
- **Lead author / year / venue:** 2025, arXiv:2502.14064
- **Description.** Autoencoder pretrained on Triad-131K (131,170 3D MRI volumes; largest MRI pretraining set), with organ-independent text descriptions constraining the visual distribution.
- **Gap.** Single-volume MRI FM; no temporal SSL.

### 1.14 VISTA3D
- **Title:** VISTA3D: A Unified Segmentation Foundation Model For 3D Medical Imaging
- **Lead author / year / venue:** Yufan He et al., CVPR 2025, arXiv:2406.05285

---

# Direction A: Longitudinal 3D Medical Imaging FM — Literature Review

**Scope.** A 3D medical imaging foundation model (FM) that natively ingests a SEQUENCE of patient-aligned 3D volumes (CT/MRI), with variable time intervals, optionally paired with longitudinal reports and EHR events, trained with temporal self-supervised objectives (interval-aware masked volume modeling, next-volume prediction in latent space, cross-modal temporal contrast). Downstream targets: disease progression, treatment response (RECIST), recurrence forecasting, longitudinal report generation.

**Date of review:** 2026-05-13.
**Coverage:** ~75 papers across 12 sections, organized to expose the white space at the intersection of (a) native 3D FM, (b) variable-interval temporal SSL, and (c) multimodal longitudinal context.

---

## 1. Foundation Models for 3D Medical Imaging (single-timepoint baseline)

### 1.1 Merlin — Stanford CCSL
- **Title:** Merlin: A Vision-Language Foundation Model for 3D Computed Tomography
- **Lead / year / venue:** Louis Blankemeier, 2024, arXiv:2406.06512 (expanded 2026)
- **Description.** 3D CT VLM trained on 15,331 abdominal CTs with 6M+ report tokens and 1.8M+ structured EHR codes.
- **What they did.** Dual supervision: (a) reports (contrastive) + (b) EHR diagnosis codes (multi-label). 752 evaluation tasks: 30 zero-shot findings, 692 phenotypes, 6-disease 5-yr risk, retrieval, report-gen, 20-organ segmentation.
- **Gap.** Single-CT input. The "5-yr risk" is supervised from future EHR labels only — no future imaging modeling. No sequence input, no interval-aware objective.

### 1.2 CT-CLIP / CT-RATE
- **Title:** Developing Generalist Foundation Models from a Multimodal Dataset for 3D Computed Tomography
- **Lead / year / venue:** Ibrahim Hamamci, 2024 arXiv:2403.17834; Nat Biomed Eng 2025
- **Description.** First public 3D CT-text dataset (25,692 chest CTs / 21,304 patients).
- **What they did.** CT-ViT + text transformer; contrastive pairing; zero-shot abnormality detection; case retrieval.
- **Gap.** Single-volume. No temporal modeling despite repeated patients in CT-RATE.

### 1.3 CT-FM — DFCI/MGB
- **Title:** Vision Foundation Models for Computed Tomography
- **Lead / year / venue:** Suraj Pai et al., 2025, arXiv:2501.09001
- **Description.** 3D CT FM pretrained label-agnostic contrastive on 148K CTs from IDC.
- **What they did.** Strong on whole-body/tumor seg, head-CT triage, retrieval, semantic clustering.
- **Gap.** Single-volume; no paired text; no longitudinal modeling.

### 1.4 RadFM
- **Title:** Towards Generalist Foundation Model for Radiology by Leveraging Web-scale 2D&3D Medical Data
- **Lead / year / venue:** Chaoyi Wu, Weidi Xie, 2024 (arXiv:2308.02463), Nat Commun 2025
- **Description.** Generalist over X-ray/CT/MRI/PET; MedMD = 13M 2D + 615K 3D + text.
- **Gap.** Single-study input; multi-image input is concatenation of unrelated studies, not a patient series.

### 1.5 M3FM
- **Title:** Medical multimodal multitask foundation model for lung cancer screening
- **Lead / year / venue:** Chuang Niu, Nat Commun 2025 (s41467-025-56822-w)
- **Description.** LCS FM on 49 data types, 163,725 chest CT series, 17 tasks. CT-ViT + Text Transformer + Task Encoder.
- **Gap.** Treats each scan as single-study + tabular; ignores NLST screening intervals at pretraining.

### 1.6 SuPreM
- **Title:** Supervised Pre-Trained 3D Models for Medical Image Analysis
- **Lead / year / venue:** Wenxuan Li, ICLR 2024 oral
- **Description.** Supervised pretrain on AbdomenAtlas 1.1 (9,262 CT volumes, 25 organs, 7 pseudo-tumor).
- **Gap.** Supervised seg; no temporal SSL.

### 1.7 VoCo
- **Title:** A Simple-yet-Effective Volume Contrastive Learning Framework
- **Lead / year / venue:** Linshan Wu, CVPR 2024, arXiv:2402.17300 (TPAMI 2025)
- **Description.** Pretext contrasts sub-volume crops against base-crop anchors via positional/geometric priors.
- **Gap.** Within-volume only; no inter-scan/time contrast.

### 1.8 3DINO / 3DINO-ViT
- **Title:** A generalizable 3D framework and model for self-supervised learning in medical imaging
- **Lead / year / venue:** npj Digital Medicine 2025 (s41746-025-02035-w)
- **Description.** Memory-efficient DINOv2-to-3D on ~100K scans (70K MRI + 27.8K CT + 566 PET).
- **Gap.** Single-volume self-distillation; no temporal pair/sequence handling.

### 1.9 BrainIAC
- **Title:** A generalizable foundation model for analysis of human brain MRI
- **Lead / year / venue:** Kann lab, Nat Neuroscience 2026 (s41593-026-02202-6)
- **Description.** Brain MRI FM, SSL on 48,519 MRIs. Brain age, dementia, time-to-stroke, brain cancer.
- **Gap.** SSL is single-scan; longitudinal tasks use FM as frozen feature extractor.

### 1.10 MedSAM / MedSAM2 / SAM-Med3D
- **Titles:** Segment Anything in Medical Images (Bo Wang, Nat Commun 2024); MedSAM2 (arXiv:2504.03600); SAM-Med3D.
- **Description.** Promptable segmentation FMs. MedSAM2 fine-tunes SAM2.1 for 3D images + temporal video with memory-attention.
- **Gap.** Segmentation focus; memory-attention is intra-scan/video — doesn't handle inter-visit intervals.

### 1.11 Aerts cancer-imaging FM
- **Title:** Foundation model for cancer imaging biomarkers
- **Lead / year / venue:** Suraj Pai, Hugo Aerts, Nat Mach Intell 6:354–367 (2024)
- **Description.** SSL conv encoder on 11,467 radiographic lesions.
- **Gap.** Lesion-patch only; single time-point. Precursor to CT-FM.

### 1.12 BTB3D
- **Title:** Better Tokens for Better 3D: Advancing Vision-Language Modeling in 3D Medical Imaging
- **Lead / year / venue:** 2025, arXiv:2510.20639
- **Description.** Causal conv encoder-decoder for 2D/3D tokens. SOTA text-to-CT synthesis and report-gen.
- **Gap.** Tokenizer for single CT; no temporal sequences.

### 1.13 Triad
- **Title:** Triad: Vision Foundation Model for 3D Magnetic Resonance Imaging
- **Lead / year / venue:** 2025, arXiv:2502.14064
- **Description.** Autoencoder on Triad-131K (131,170 3D MRI volumes; largest MRI pretraining).
- **Gap.** Single-volume; no temporal SSL.

### 1.14 VISTA3D
- **Title:** VISTA3D: A Unified Segmentation Foundation Model For 3D Medical Imaging
- **Lead / year / venue:** Yufan He, CVPR 2025, arXiv:2406.05285
- **Description.** Unified 3D automatic (127 classes) + interactive segmentation.
- **Gap.** Segmentation only.

### 1.15 Decipher-MR (GE HealthCare)
- **Title:** Decipher-MR: A Vision-Language Foundation Model for 3D MRI Representations
- **Lead / year / venue:** npj Digital Medicine 2026 (s41746-026-02596-4); arXiv:2509.21249
- **Description.** 3D MRI VL FM on 203K MRI series / 22,594 studies, multi-vendor, ages 0–90.
- **Gap.** Single-study; modular task heads on frozen encoder.

### 1.16 MedImageInsight
- **Title:** Open-Source Embedding Model for General Domain Medical Imaging
- **Lead / year / venue:** Microsoft, 2024, arXiv:2410.06542
- **Description.** Domain-general embedding model.
- **Gap.** 2D; no temporal modeling.

### 1.17 BiomedGPT
- **Title:** A generalist vision–language foundation model for diverse biomedical tasks
- **Lead / year / venue:** Kai Zhang, Nat Med 2024
- **Description.** Open-source generalist VLM (16/25 SOTA).
- **Gap.** Largely 2D; sequence-of-volumes not native.

### 1.18 BioViL-T (CXR temporal baseline)
- **Title:** Learning to Exploit Temporal Structure for Biomedical Vision–Language Processing
- **Lead / year / venue:** Shruthi Bannur, Microsoft Health Futures, CVPR 2023
- **Description.** CNN-Transformer hybrid on CXR sequences + paired reports; SOTA on progression classification, phrase grounding, longitudinal report gen.
- **Gap.** 2D CXR not 3D; no interval-conditioning; pair-based.

### 1.19 EchoCLIP / EchoPrime / EchoFM / Echo-Vision-FM
- EchoCLIP (Nat Med 2024); EchoPrime (Nature 2026, arXiv:2410.09704); EchoFM (arXiv:2410.23413); Echo-Vision-FM (Nat Commun 2025).
- **Gap.** Ultrasound video; periodicity assumption; no multi-month sequence.

### 1.20 NeuroSTORM (4D fMRI FM)
- **Title:** Towards a general-purpose foundation model for fMRI analysis
- **Lead / year / venue:** Wang, Nat Biomed Eng 2026 (s41551-026-01666-y); arXiv:2506.11167
- **Description.** Pretrained on 28.65M fMRI frames, 50K participants; Shifted-Window Mamba + STRD masked pretraining.
- **Gap.** Intra-scan seconds, not inter-visit weeks/years.

---

## 2. Label-side Longitudinal: 3D imaging + future EHR labels

### 2.1 TTE Pretraining (Stanford) — KEY BASELINE
- **Title:** Time-to-Event Pretraining for 3D Medical Imaging
- **Lead / year / venue:** Zepeng Huo, Jason Fries, A. Chaudhari, Nigam Shah, ICLR 2025, arXiv:2411.09361
- **Description.** Pretrains 3D CT encoder by predicting time-to-event distributions across thousands of EHR endpoints.
- **Numbers.** 18,945 CTs / 4.2M 2D images. +23.7% AUROC, +29.4% Harrell's C across 8 benchmarks.
- **Gap.** Single CT input; only labels are temporal. No image-sequence modeling.

### 2.2 Merlin 5-yr Disease Risk (§1.1).

### 2.3 Sybil
- **Title:** Sybil: A Validated Deep Learning Model to Predict Future Lung Cancer Risk From a Single LDCT
- **Lead / year / venue:** Peter Mikhael, R. Barzilay, MIT Jameel Clinic, JCO 2023
- **Description.** Predicts 1–6 yr lung cancer from one LDCT; AUC 0.92 / C-index 0.75 on NLST.
- **Gap.** Single CT despite NLST being longitudinal. Natural baseline to surpass with full screening history.

### 2.4 MIRAI / LRP-NET (breast 2D)
- Lehman, Barzilay 2021 / Karaman 2023 — risk from current + priors.
- **Gap.** 2D, not 3D.

---

## 3. Image-side Longitudinal: ≥2 imaging timepoints

### 3a. Two-timepoint (Siamese / pair-based)

**3a.1 LSSL** — Qingyu Zhao, E. Adeli, K. Pohl, MIDL 2020 / MedIA 2021, arXiv:2006.06930. Autoencoder + cosine loss disentangling brain age from pair MRIs. Gap: 2-time, brain-only, small.

**3a.2 LNE** — Jiahong Ouyang, MICCAI 2021 (PMC10168684). Graph in latent space aligning each subject's trajectory to neighbors. Gap: 2-time, brain, fixed-Δt.

**3a.3 STAMP** — 2025, arXiv:2512.23441. Stochastic Siamese MAE; reconstruction as conditional VI; ViT on 2 OCT + 1 MRI longitudinal. Gap: pairs only; 2D/2.5D.

**3a.4 TeViT/TaViT** — Thomas Li, 2022/23 (arXiv:2209.01676, PMC10353776). TeViT adds time-distance to PE; TaViT scales attention by continuous Δt. Gap: small NLST subsets; nodule-feature input.

**3a.5 LongFormer-MRI** — Qiuhui Chen, Yi Hong, WACV 2024, arXiv:2302.00901. Hybrid 3D-CNN + Transformer for AD; spatial-then-temporal attention. SOTA on ADNI/OASIS/AIBL. Gap: supervised; no SSL pretraining.

**3a.6 MambaX-Net** — 2025, arXiv:2510.17529. Dual-input Mamba for paired-visit segmentation (prostate AS). Gap: pair seg, not FM.

### 3b. Multi-timepoint (≥3 scans)

**3b.1 SSL-AD** — 2025, arXiv:2509.10453. Adapts 3 temporal SSL methods to 3D brain MRI; variable-length; 3,161 patients across 4 AD datasets. Gap: brain-only, AD-only, small, no text.

**3b.2 CRONOS** — KEY COMPARATOR. 2025, arXiv:2512.16577 (OpenReview XxqdbYD74l). Many-to-one prediction from multiple past scans; discrete + continuous timestamps; spatio-temporal velocity field in 3D voxel space; Fourier embeddings for flow + clock time. Datasets: Cine-MRI, perfusion CT, longitudinal MRI. Gap: trajectory forecaster, not generic FM; no text/EHR. The Fourier continuous-time recipe is reusable.

**3b.3 3DTINC** — Taha Emre, H. Bogunović, IEEE TMI 2024, arXiv:2312.16980. Non-contrastive SSL with OCT-specific 3D augs; explicit temporal similarity loss. Gap: OCT-only.

**3b.4 L-MAE** — Rachid Zeghlache, Comput Biol Med 2024, arXiv:2403.16272. ViT MAE with (i) time-aware PE and (ii) disease-progression-aware masking. 2D fundus. Recipe is transferable to 3D.

**3b.5 LongL-Net** — PNAS Nexus 2022. RNN+CNN AMD fundus longitudinal. 2D.

**3b.6 TAMME (Holistic Time-Aware)** — Susetzky, Qiu, Braren, Rueckert, MICCAI 2025 paper 3193. Element = sum of (type) + (spec) + (Δt embedding) + (value); open-vocab; mixed modalities incl. images as tokens; irregular intervals. Gap: no native 3D image encoder pretraining.

### 3c. Per-patient temporal contrastive / chronological

**3c.1 LEARNER** — 2024, arXiv:2411.01144. Uses coarse inter-patient labels to learn intra-patient progression; TSM + ResNet-18. Gap: 2D/2.5D, small.

**3c.2 ChronoCon (Chronological Contrastive Learning)** — 2026, arXiv:2603.21935. Patient visit order as ranking signal (Rank-N-Contrast generalization). Rheumatoid arthritis radiographs. Gap: 2D, monotonic progression.

**3c.3 Temporal-SCL** — 2023, arXiv:2312.05933 (PMC10976929). Tabular patient time-series.

**3c.4 LRP-NET** — Longitudinal mammography risk via CNN-LSTM. 2D.

---

## 4. Disease Progression Prediction

**4.1 TADPOLE** — Marinescu et al., 2018–21 (arXiv:1805.03909, 2002.03419). 92 algos / 33 teams predicting monthly clinical Dx, ADAS-Cog13, ventricle vol 5-yr from ADNI. Gap: tabular dominates; raw-image-sequence baseline underrepresented.

**4.2 Future Brain Atrophy** — Wachinger / TimeFlow lab follow-ups.

**4.3 Glioma progression** — Multi-Task Diffusion (arXiv:2509.10824) generates future FLAIR + pixel-level tumor evolution maps.

**4.4 Sybil** (§2.3).

**4.5 Brain age models** — Cole 2019; AgeDiffuse 2023; recent multi-site framework (s41514-025-00260-x npj Aging 2025).

**4.6 BrLP** — Lemuel Puglisi, MICCAI 2024 early-accept / MedIA 2025 / arXiv:2502.08560. Latent diffusion on 3D brain MRI conditioned on subject metadata + disease-dynamics aux model; Latent Average Stabilization. 11,730 T1w / 2,805 subjects + ext 2,257/962. Gap: generative; brain-only; no text/EHR.

**4.7 Enhancing Spatiotemporal Disease Progression** — arXiv:2405.03328.

---

## 5. Treatment Response Prediction

**5.1 RECIST automation** — Systematic review Cancers 2024/2026 PMC12984241. nnU-Net + 3D U-Net DSC 0.85, classification acc 0.77 (κ=0.60). LLM-based report mining (DeepSeek-V3, GatorTron) 96.5%/89% acc, κ 0.85–0.90. "Toward automating RECIST 1.1" ASCO 2023 e13545. Gap: no general FM end-to-end on multi-time CTs.

**5.2 Xu, Mak, Aerts (Nat Commun 2021, s41467-021-22188-y)** — Multi-task DL on longitudinal NSCLC CT; significant for survival, progression, distant mets, locoregional recurrence.

**5.3 Immunotherapy response** — Front Immunol 2025 (TIME profiling, longitudinal CT radiomics); Cancer Immunol Immunother 2024 (DL + habitat radiomics, AUC 0.94/0.87). Gap: radiomics-DL, small cohorts.

**5.4 ESCC neoadjuvant** — Niu et al., npj Precision Oncology 2025.

**5.5 RADAR CARE** — JCO Precision Oncology 2025. NSCLC recurrence multimodal transformer; baseline AUC 0.82, longitudinal 0.77, combined 0.85.

**5.6 HCC recurrence from baseline MRI** — Sci Rep 2023, VGG16+XGBoost.

---

## 6. Longitudinal Image Synthesis / Forecasting

**6.1 SADM** — Jee Seok Yoon, IPMI 2023, arXiv:2212.08228. Diffusion + sequence-aware transformer; handles missing frames; autoregressive. Cardiac + brain MRI.

**6.2 Forecasting Future Anatomies** — arXiv:2511.02558 (Nov 2025). Five archs (UNet, U²-Net, UNETR, Time-Embedding UNet, ODE-UNet) predict full future brain MRI from baseline; ADNI/AIBL.

**6.3 TimeFlow** — Bailiang Jian, D. Rueckert, C. Wachinger, arXiv:2501.08667 (IEEE TPAMI 2025). U-Net with temporal conditioning; continuous-function-of-age; inter/extrapolation consistency.

**6.4 Temporal Flow Matching (TFM)** — Nico Albert Disch, MIC-DKFZ, arXiv:2508.21580. Unified generative trajectory; 3D, multiple priors, irregular sampling; falls back to nearest-image predictor. Benchmarks ACDC, LUMIERE, ISLES. Code: github.com/MIC-DKFZ/Temporal-Flow-Matching.

**6.5 Latent Flow Matching for Longitudinal Imaging** — Hao Chen, ICLR 2026, arXiv:2512.09185. ArcRank Loss latent + FM on disease-specific time scale T; Δ-RMAE metric.

**6.6 Conditional Latent Diffusion (CLDM)** — Mouadden, Christodoulidis, Vakalopoulou, MICCAI 2025 paper 2656. Universal 2D/3D encoder + temporal transformer + cond LDM. Predicts ILD progression in systemic sclerosis + report gen.

**6.7 ImageFlowNet** — ICASSP 2025 Oral, Krishnaswamy lab, arXiv:2406.14794. Multiscale joint patient-time latent + Neural ODE/SDE flow field. Retinal GA, MS, GBM.

**6.8 Conditional Neural ODE for PD** — arXiv:2511.04789.

**6.9 Temporal Atlas-Guided Generation via Geometric Latent** — MICCAI 2025 paper 1050.

**6.10 Conditional Diffusion + Ordinal Regression** — OpenReview 9UGfOJBuL8.

**6.11 BrLP** (§4.6).

---

## 7. Continuous-Time Embeddings / Position Encoding for Irregular Intervals

**7.1 Time2Vec** — Kazemi 2019, arXiv:1907.05321. Learnable ω, φ sine + linear time embedding.

**7.2 Sinusoidal / Fourier** — CRONOS uses Fourier features for flow-step + clock-time. "Continuous-Time Linear Positional Embedding for Irregular Time Series Forecasting" arXiv:2409.20092.

**7.3 Δt-aware attention** — TaViT (§3a.4); "Time-Aware Attention for EHR" arXiv:2507.14847; "Time-to-Event Transformer" arXiv:2602.10385.

**7.4 Neural ODE for medical sequence** — ImageFlowNet, CNODE, BrLP aux. Review: Artif Intell Rev 2024 (s10462-024-10894-0).

**7.5 Time-aware MAE** — L-MAE (§3b.4); 3D MAE+spatiotemporal transformer for 4D fMRI (PubMed 41197226).

**7.6 Temporal RoPE** — "Learning to Rotate" arXiv:2604.24717.

---

## 8. Cross-modal Temporal Models (image + text + EHR + time)

**8.1 BioViL-T** (§1.18).
**8.2 TAMME** (§3b.6).
**8.3 IRENE** — Hong-Yu Zhou, Nat Biomed Eng 2023. Unified transformer for image+text+structured with bidirectional cross-modal attention. Gap: single-timepoint.
**8.4 ETHOS** — npj DM 2024, arXiv:2407.21124. Tokenized Patient Health Timelines; zero-shot event prediction. EHR-only.
**8.5 Foresight** — Lancet Digital Health 2024, arXiv:2212.08072. GPT-2-based EHR timeline. EHR-only.
**8.6 CoMET** — Epic/Microsoft 2025, arXiv:2508.12104. Decoder-only ≤1B params on 118M patients / 115B events. Power-law scaling for medical-event FMs. EHR-only.
**8.7 MAIRA-2** — Microsoft, arXiv:2406.04449. Grounded report gen with frontal+lateral+prior frontal+prior report+Indication/Technique/Comparison. CXR pair only.
**8.8 Longitudinal CXR report-gen** — HERGen (MICCAI 2024), MLRG (CVPR 2025, arXiv:2502.20056). Survey: arXiv:2510.12444.

---

## 9. Benchmarks / Eval Datasets

**9.1 3D-RAD** — arXiv:2506.11147, NeurIPS 2025. 170K Q-A entries, 6 VQA tasks including longitudinal/static temporal diagnosis. 18+ diseases. Existing VLMs fail on multi-temporal → key benchmark for Direction A.
**9.2 TADPOLE** (§4.1).
**9.3 INSPECT** — NeurIPS 2023 D&B, arXiv:2311.10798, Stanford Shah lab. 19,402 patients / 23,248 CTs + reports + longitudinal EHR; **first to link longitudinal EHR + 3D CT + reports**.
**9.4 NLST** — 26,254 LDCT patients, 3 screening rounds (T0/T1/T2), ~75K exams. NLSTseg adds pixel masks (Sci Data 2025).
**9.5 BraTS-Reg / BraTS 2024 / 2025 Lighthouse** — Baheti arXiv:2112.06979; longitudinal glioma; post-treatment cohort added 2024.
**9.6 HECKTOR 2020–25** — Andrearczyk, Depeursinge. FDG-PET/CT seg + RFS prediction; >1200 patients / 11 centers; best PFS C-index ~0.72.
**9.7 ADNI / OASIS / AIBL** — Brain longitudinal trilogy.
**9.8 ProstateX-AS** — MambaX-Net.
**9.9 LUMIERE / ISLES** — TFM benchmark.
**9.10 Longitudinal-MIMIC** — 26,625 patients multi-visit CXR + reports.
**9.11 OPHDIAT / AREDS** — L-MAE / 3DTINC / LONGL-Net.
**9.12 Epic Cosmos** — 300M-patient EHR scale.

---

## 10. White Space Analysis

**10.1 Architecture choices not tried**
- 3D-volume encoder + Δt-aware temporal attention in one FM trained on real inter-visit intervals (CRONOS is a forecaster; SSL-AD is brain-only small-scale).
- Per-visit cross-attention between 3D image tokens and EHR-event tokens with shared continuous-time PE (Merlin does single-time joint; nobody fuses 3D-image-sequence + EHR-sequence under one time axis).
- Mixed-modality sequences (CT@t1, MRI@t2, report@t3, lab@t4) under one tokenization (closest: CLDM, generative only).

**10.2 Objective combinations not tried**
- **Interval-aware Masked Volume Modeling (IA-MVM)**: masking ratio modulated by Δt — short Δt = high redundancy = aggressive masking; long Δt = mask conservatively, predict deltas. L-MAE prototypes this in 2D fundus only.
- **Next-volume prediction in latent space** as primary autoregressive SSL objective. CRONOS / Latent FM frame this as forecasting; nobody uses it as the *primary* pretraining objective for a representation FM.
- **Cross-modal temporal contrast**: match volume@t with report/EHR-window around t, push apart same-patient at t' ≠ t. Closest: ChronoCon (2D) / Temporal-SCL (tabular).
- **Trajectory-aligned contrast across patients**: LNE-style neighborhood embedding at FM scale across diseases.

**10.3 Clinical evaluations missing**
- RECIST prediction from ≥3 prior CTs with interval awareness + zero-shot.
- Cross-disease, cross-modality progression benchmarks (3D-RAD leaderboard).
- Time-to-event Harrell's C across ≥5 organ systems from one 3D temporal FM checkpoint.
- Longitudinal report-gen with prior-image + prior-report for non-CXR 3D modalities.

**10.4 Data regimes not tried**
- Unified pretraining on NLST + INSPECT + AbdomenAtlas-longitudinal + ADNI/OASIS + UK Biobank repeat-imaging.
- Re-tokenize Stanford PACS (used by Merlin/TTE) as 3D image sequences.
- Federated longitudinal pretraining across institutions.

---

## 11. Direct competitors — top 8

1. **TTE Pretraining (Stanford 2024, arXiv:2411.09361)** — same goal, but input is single CT with temporal labels. Direction A flips this.
2. **SSL-AD (arXiv:2509.10453)** — actual 3D temporal SSL on brain MRI sequences. Narrow but in-domain template.
3. **CRONOS (arXiv:2512.16577)** — multi-input continuous-time 4D forecasting; provides continuous-time recipe.
4. **Temporal Flow Matching (arXiv:2508.21580, MIC-DKFZ)** — sibling generative 3D trajectory.
5. **Merlin (arXiv:2406.06512)** — single-CT 3D VLM with longitudinal EHR-label supervision.
6. **BrLP (arXiv:2502.08560)** — 3D brain MRI latent-diffusion progression.
7. **TAMME / Holistic Time-Aware (MICCAI 2025)** — multimodal time-aware transformer with explicit Δt; lacks native 3D image encoder.
8. **BioViL-T / MAIRA-2** — 2D-CXR longitudinal-VLM SOTA; methodological reference.

**Next 5:** L-MAE, ImageFlowNet, HERGen/MLRG, CT-CLIP/CT-RATE, 3D-RAD.

---

## 12. Methodological Building Blocks Ready to Use

**12.1 Public code/checkpoints.** Merlin (StanfordMIMI), CT-FM, CT-CLIP/CT-RATE, 3DINO (AICONSlab), Triad/VISTA3D/SuPreM/VoCo/BrainIAC/Decipher-MR (all open), Sybil (reginabarzilaygroup), SADM (ubc-tea), Temporal Flow Matching (MIC-DKFZ), ImageFlowNet (KrishnaswamyLab), LNE (ouyangjiahong), 3D-RAD (Tang-xiaoxiao), BioViL-T + MAIRA-2 (Microsoft on HF).

**12.2 Temporal recipes to compose.** Fourier continuous-time PE (CRONOS); Δt-scaled attention (TaViT); time-aware PE for MAE (L-MAE); time-aware multimodal tokenization (TAMME); sequence-aware diffusion conditioning (SADM); trajectory-aligned neighborhood loss (LNE); TTE prediction loss (Huo); PHT-style EHR tokenizer (ETHOS/Foresight/CoMET).

**12.3 Evaluation benchmarks ready.** RECIST 1.1 (Cancers 2025 baselines); INSPECT; 3D-RAD multi-temporal subset; ADNI MCI-conversion 1/2/3-yr; NLST 1–6 yr (Sybil baseline + multi-screen input); HECKTOR PFS C-index; BraTS-Reg / 2024 post-treatment; TADPOLE 5-yr forecast; OPHDIAT / AREDS (control 2D modalities).

**12.4 Likely loss combo for Direction A**
- α · IA-MVM (interval-aware masked volume modeling, reconstruction)
- + β · NVP-LS (next-volume prediction in latent space, MSE or flow matching)
- + γ · CMTC (cross-modal temporal contrast: align volume(t) with text/EHR window around t; push apart same patient at t')
- + δ · TTE head (Huo-style; only needs longitudinal labels at fine-tune)
- + ε · Trajectory-manifold loss (LNE-style)

Encoder: 3D-ViT or U-Net-ViT-hybrid à la M3T/CT-ViT/SwinUNETR, with Fourier(Δt) added to patch tokens + Δt-scaled cross-visit attention.

# Direction A: Longitudinal 3D Medical Imaging FM — Literature Review

**Scope.** A 3D medical imaging foundation model (FM) that natively ingests a SEQUENCE of patient-aligned 3D volumes (CT/MRI), with variable time intervals, optionally paired with longitudinal reports and EHR events, trained with temporal self-supervised objectives (interval-aware masked volume modeling, next-volume prediction in latent space, cross-modal temporal contrast). Downstream targets: disease progression, treatment response (RECIST), recurrence forecasting, longitudinal report generation.

**Date of review:** 2026-05-13.
**Coverage:** ~75 papers across 12 sections, organized to expose the white space at the intersection of (a) native 3D FM, (b) variable-interval temporal SSL, and (c) multimodal longitudinal context.

---

## 1. Foundation Models for 3D Medical Imaging (single-timepoint baseline)

### 1.1 Merlin — Stanford CCSL
- **Title:** Merlin: A Vision-Language Foundation Model for 3D Computed Tomography
- **Lead / year / venue:** Louis Blankemeier, 2024, arXiv:2406.06512 (expanded 2026)
- **Description.** 3D CT VLM trained on 15,331 abdominal CTs with 6M+ report tokens and 1.8M+ structured EHR codes.
- **What they did.** Dual supervision: (a) reports (contrastive) + (b) EHR diagnosis codes (multi-label). 752 evaluation tasks: 30 zero-shot findings, 692 phenotypes, 6-disease 5-yr risk, retrieval, report-gen, 20-organ segmentation.
- **Gap.** Single-CT input. The "5-yr risk" is supervised from future EHR labels only — no future imaging modeling. No sequence input, no interval-aware objective.

### 1.2 CT-CLIP / CT-RATE
- **Title:** Developing Generalist Foundation Models from a Multimodal Dataset for 3D Computed Tomography
- **Lead / year / venue:** Ibrahim Hamamci, 2024 arXiv:2403.17834; Nat Biomed Eng 2025
- **Description.** First public 3D CT-text dataset (25,692 chest CTs / 21,304 patients).
- **What they did.** CT-ViT + text transformer; contrastive pairing; zero-shot abnormality detection; case retrieval.
- **Gap.** Single-volume. No temporal modeling despite repeated patients in CT-RATE.

### 1.3 CT-FM — DFCI/MGB
- **Title:** Vision Foundation Models for Computed Tomography
- **Lead / year / venue:** Suraj Pai et al., 2025, arXiv:2501.09001
- **Description.** 3D CT FM pretrained label-agnostic contrastive on 148K CTs from IDC.
- **What they did.** Strong on whole-body/tumor seg, head-CT triage, retrieval, semantic clustering.
- **Gap.** Single-volume; no paired text; no longitudinal modeling.

### 1.4 RadFM
- **Title:** Towards Generalist Foundation Model for Radiology by Leveraging Web-scale 2D&3D Medical Data
- **Lead / year / venue:** Chaoyi Wu, Weidi Xie, 2024 (arXiv:2308.02463), Nat Commun 2025
- **Description.** Generalist over X-ray/CT/MRI/PET; MedMD = 13M 2D + 615K 3D + text.
- **Gap.** Single-study input; multi-image input is concatenation of unrelated studies, not a patient series.

### 1.5 M3FM
- **Title:** Medical multimodal multitask foundation model for lung cancer screening
- **Lead / year / venue:** Chuang Niu, Nat Commun 2025 (s41467-025-56822-w)
- **Description.** LCS FM on 49 data types, 163,725 chest CT series, 17 tasks. CT-ViT + Text Transformer + Task Encoder.
- **Gap.** Treats each scan as single-study + tabular; ignores NLST screening intervals at pretraining.

### 1.6 SuPreM
- **Title:** Supervised Pre-Trained 3D Models for Medical Image Analysis
- **Lead / year / venue:** Wenxuan Li, ICLR 2024 oral
- **Description.** Supervised pretrain on AbdomenAtlas 1.1 (9,262 CT volumes, 25 organs, 7 pseudo-tumor).
- **Gap.** Supervised seg; no temporal SSL.

### 1.7 VoCo
- **Title:** A Simple-yet-Effective Volume Contrastive Learning Framework
- **Lead / year / venue:** Linshan Wu, CVPR 2024, arXiv:2402.17300 (TPAMI 2025)
- **Description.** Pretext contrasts sub-volume crops against base-crop anchors via positional/geometric priors.
- **Gap.** Within-volume only; no inter-scan/time contrast.

### 1.8 3DINO / 3DINO-ViT
- **Title:** A generalizable 3D framework and model for self-supervised learning in medical imaging
- **Lead / year / venue:** npj Digital Medicine 2025 (s41746-025-02035-w)
- **Description.** Memory-efficient DINOv2-to-3D on ~100K scans (70K MRI + 27.8K CT + 566 PET).
- **Gap.** Single-volume self-distillation; no temporal pair/sequence handling.

### 1.9 BrainIAC
- **Title:** A generalizable foundation model for analysis of human brain MRI
- **Lead / year / venue:** Kann lab, Nat Neuroscience 2026 (s41593-026-02202-6)
- **Description.** Brain MRI FM, SSL on 48,519 MRIs. Brain age, dementia, time-to-stroke, brain cancer.
- **Gap.** SSL is single-scan; longitudinal tasks use FM as frozen feature extractor.

### 1.10 MedSAM / MedSAM2 / SAM-Med3D
- **Titles:** Segment Anything in Medical Images (Bo Wang, Nat Commun 2024); MedSAM2 (arXiv:2504.03600); SAM-Med3D.
- **Description.** Promptable segmentation FMs. MedSAM2 fine-tunes SAM2.1 for 3D images + temporal video with memory-attention.
- **Gap.** Segmentation focus; memory-attention is intra-scan/video — doesn't handle inter-visit intervals.

### 1.11 Aerts cancer-imaging FM
- **Title:** Foundation model for cancer imaging biomarkers
- **Lead / year / venue:** Suraj Pai, Hugo Aerts, Nat Mach Intell 6:354–367 (2024)
- **Description.** SSL conv encoder on 11,467 radiographic lesions.
- **Gap.** Lesion-patch only; single time-point. Precursor to CT-FM.

### 1.12 BTB3D
- **Title:** Better Tokens for Better 3D: Advancing Vision-Language Modeling in 3D Medical Imaging
- **Lead / year / venue:** 2025, arXiv:2510.20639
- **Description.** Causal conv encoder-decoder for 2D/3D tokens. SOTA text-to-CT synthesis and report-gen.
- **Gap.** Tokenizer for single CT; no temporal sequences.

### 1.13 Triad
- **Title:** Triad: Vision Foundation Model for 3D Magnetic Resonance Imaging
- **Lead / year / venue:** 2025, arXiv:2502.14064
- **Description.** Autoencoder on Triad-131K (131,170 3D MRI volumes; largest MRI pretraining).
- **Gap.** Single-volume; no temporal SSL.

### 1.14 VISTA3D
- **Title:** VISTA3D: A Unified Segmentation Foundation Model For 3D Medical Imaging
- **Lead / year / venue:** Yufan He, CVPR 2025, arXiv:2406.05285
- **Description.** Unified 3D automatic (127 classes) + interactive segmentation.
- **Gap.** Segmentation only.

### 1.15 Decipher-MR (GE HealthCare)
- **Title:** Decipher-MR: A Vision-Language Foundation Model for 3D MRI Representations
- **Lead / year / venue:** npj Digital Medicine 2026 (s41746-026-02596-4); arXiv:2509.21249
- **Description.** 3D MRI VL FM on 203K MRI series / 22,594 studies, multi-vendor, ages 0–90.
- **Gap.** Single-study; modular task heads on frozen encoder.

### 1.16 MedImageInsight
- **Title:** Open-Source Embedding Model for General Domain Medical Imaging
- **Lead / year / venue:** Microsoft, 2024, arXiv:2410.06542
- **Description.** Domain-general embedding model.
- **Gap.** 2D; no temporal modeling.

### 1.17 BiomedGPT
- **Title:** A generalist vision–language foundation model for diverse biomedical tasks
- **Lead / year / venue:** Kai Zhang, Nat Med 2024
- **Description.** Open-source generalist VLM (16/25 SOTA).
- **Gap.** Largely 2D; sequence-of-volumes not native.

### 1.18 BioViL-T (CXR temporal baseline)
- **Title:** Learning to Exploit Temporal Structure for Biomedical Vision–Language Processing
- **Lead / year / venue:** Shruthi Bannur, Microsoft Health Futures, CVPR 2023
- **Description.** CNN-Transformer hybrid on CXR sequences + paired reports; SOTA on progression classification, phrase grounding, longitudinal report gen.
- **Gap.** 2D CXR not 3D; no interval-conditioning; pair-based.

### 1.19 EchoCLIP / EchoPrime / EchoFM / Echo-Vision-FM
- EchoCLIP (Nat Med 2024); EchoPrime (Nature 2026, arXiv:2410.09704); EchoFM (arXiv:2410.23413); Echo-Vision-FM (Nat Commun 2025).
- **Gap.** Ultrasound video; periodicity assumption; no multi-month sequence.

### 1.20 NeuroSTORM (4D fMRI FM)
- **Title:** Towards a general-purpose foundation model for fMRI analysis
- **Lead / year / venue:** Wang, Nat Biomed Eng 2026 (s41551-026-01666-y); arXiv:2506.11167
- **Description.** Pretrained on 28.65M fMRI frames, 50K participants; Shifted-Window Mamba + STRD masked pretraining.
- **Gap.** Intra-scan seconds, not inter-visit weeks/years.

---

## 2. Label-side Longitudinal: 3D imaging + future EHR labels

### 2.1 TTE Pretraining (Stanford) — KEY BASELINE
- **Title:** Time-to-Event Pretraining for 3D Medical Imaging
- **Lead / year / venue:** Zepeng Huo, Jason Fries, A. Chaudhari, Nigam Shah, ICLR 2025, arXiv:2411.09361
- **Description.** Pretrains 3D CT encoder by predicting time-to-event distributions across thousands of EHR endpoints.
- **Numbers.** 18,945 CTs / 4.2M 2D images. +23.7% AUROC, +29.4% Harrell's C across 8 benchmarks.
- **Gap.** Single CT input; only labels are temporal. No image-sequence modeling.

### 2.2 Merlin 5-yr Disease Risk (§1.1).

### 2.3 Sybil
- **Title:** Sybil: A Validated Deep Learning Model to Predict Future Lung Cancer Risk From a Single LDCT
- **Lead / year / venue:** Peter Mikhael, R. Barzilay, MIT Jameel Clinic, JCO 2023
- **Description.** Predicts 1–6 yr lung cancer from one LDCT; AUC 0.92 / C-index 0.75 on NLST.
- **Gap.** Single CT despite NLST being longitudinal. Natural baseline to surpass with full screening history.

### 2.4 MIRAI / LRP-NET (breast 2D)
- Lehman, Barzilay 2021 / Karaman 2023 — risk from current + priors.
- **Gap.** 2D, not 3D.

---

## 3. Image-side Longitudinal: ≥2 imaging timepoints

### 3a. Two-timepoint (Siamese / pair-based)

**3a.1 LSSL** — Qingyu Zhao, E. Adeli, K. Pohl, MIDL 2020 / MedIA 2021, arXiv:2006.06930. Autoencoder + cosine loss disentangling brain age from pair MRIs. Gap: 2-time, brain-only, small.

**3a.2 LNE** — Jiahong Ouyang, MICCAI 2021 (PMC10168684). Graph in latent space aligning each subject's trajectory to neighbors. Gap: 2-time, brain, fixed-Δt.

**3a.3 STAMP** — 2025, arXiv:2512.23441. Stochastic Siamese MAE; reconstruction as conditional VI; ViT on 2 OCT + 1 MRI longitudinal. Gap: pairs only; 2D/2.5D.

**3a.4 TeViT/TaViT** — Thomas Li, 2022/23 (arXiv:2209.01676, PMC10353776). TeViT adds time-distance to PE; TaViT scales attention by continuous Δt. Gap: small NLST subsets; nodule-feature input.

**3a.5 LongFormer-MRI** — Qiuhui Chen, Yi Hong, WACV 2024, arXiv:2302.00901. Hybrid 3D-CNN + Transformer for AD; spatial-then-temporal attention. SOTA on ADNI/OASIS/AIBL. Gap: supervised; no SSL pretraining.

**3a.6 MambaX-Net** — 2025, arXiv:2510.17529. Dual-input Mamba for paired-visit segmentation (prostate AS). Gap: pair seg, not FM.

### 3b. Multi-timepoint (≥3 scans)

**3b.1 SSL-AD** — 2025, arXiv:2509.10453. Adapts 3 temporal SSL methods to 3D brain MRI; variable-length; 3,161 patients across 4 AD datasets. Gap: brain-only, AD-only, small, no text.

**3b.2 CRONOS** — KEY COMPARATOR. 2025, arXiv:2512.16577 (OpenReview XxqdbYD74l). Many-to-one prediction from multiple past scans; discrete + continuous timestamps; spatio-temporal velocity field in 3D voxel space; Fourier embeddings for flow + clock time. Datasets: Cine-MRI, perfusion CT, longitudinal MRI. Gap: trajectory forecaster, not generic FM; no text/EHR. The Fourier continuous-time recipe is reusable.

**3b.3 3DTINC** — Taha Emre, H. Bogunović, IEEE TMI 2024, arXiv:2312.16980. Non-contrastive SSL with OCT-specific 3D augs; explicit temporal similarity loss. Gap: OCT-only.

**3b.4 L-MAE** — Rachid Zeghlache, Comput Biol Med 2024, arXiv:2403.16272. ViT MAE with (i) time-aware PE and (ii) disease-progression-aware masking. 2D fundus. Recipe is transferable to 3D.

**3b.5 LongL-Net** — PNAS Nexus 2022. RNN+CNN AMD fundus longitudinal. 2D.

**3b.6 TAMME (Holistic Time-Aware)** — Susetzky, Qiu, Braren, Rueckert, MICCAI 2025 paper 3193. Element = sum of (type) + (spec) + (Δt embedding) + (value); open-vocab; mixed modalities incl. images as tokens; irregular intervals. Gap: no native 3D image encoder pretraining.

### 3c. Per-patient temporal contrastive / chronological

**3c.1 LEARNER** — 2024, arXiv:2411.01144. Uses coarse inter-patient labels to learn intra-patient progression; TSM + ResNet-18. Gap: 2D/2.5D, small.

**3c.2 ChronoCon (Chronological Contrastive Learning)** — 2026, arXiv:2603.21935. Patient visit order as ranking signal (Rank-N-Contrast generalization). Rheumatoid arthritis radiographs. Gap: 2D, monotonic progression.

**3c.3 Temporal-SCL** — 2023, arXiv:2312.05933 (PMC10976929). Tabular patient time-series.

**3c.4 LRP-NET** — Longitudinal mammography risk via CNN-LSTM. 2D.

---

## 4. Disease Progression Prediction

**4.1 TADPOLE** — Marinescu et al., 2018–21 (arXiv:1805.03909, 2002.03419). 92 algos / 33 teams predicting monthly clinical Dx, ADAS-Cog13, ventricle vol 5-yr from ADNI. Gap: tabular dominates; raw-image-sequence baseline underrepresented.

**4.2 Future Brain Atrophy** — Wachinger / TimeFlow lab follow-ups.

**4.3 Glioma progression** — Multi-Task Diffusion (arXiv:2509.10824) generates future FLAIR + pixel-level tumor evolution maps.

**4.4 Sybil** (§2.3).

**4.5 Brain age models** — Cole 2019; AgeDiffuse 2023; recent multi-site framework (s41514-025-00260-x npj Aging 2025).

**4.6 BrLP** — Lemuel Puglisi, MICCAI 2024 early-accept / MedIA 2025 / arXiv:2502.08560. Latent diffusion on 3D brain MRI conditioned on subject metadata + disease-dynamics aux model; Latent Average Stabilization. 11,730 T1w / 2,805 subjects + ext 2,257/962. Gap: generative; brain-only; no text/EHR.

**4.7 Enhancing Spatiotemporal Disease Progression** — arXiv:2405.03328.

---

## 5. Treatment Response Prediction

**5.1 RECIST automation** — Systematic review Cancers 2024/2026 PMC12984241. nnU-Net + 3D U-Net DSC 0.85, classification acc 0.77 (κ=0.60). LLM-based report mining (DeepSeek-V3, GatorTron) 96.5%/89% acc, κ 0.85–0.90. "Toward automating RECIST 1.1" ASCO 2023 e13545. Gap: no general FM end-to-end on multi-time CTs.

**5.2 Xu, Mak, Aerts (Nat Commun 2021, s41467-021-22188-y)** — Multi-task DL on longitudinal NSCLC CT; significant for survival, progression, distant mets, locoregional recurrence.

**5.3 Immunotherapy response** — Front Immunol 2025 (TIME profiling, longitudinal CT radiomics); Cancer Immunol Immunother 2024 (DL + habitat radiomics, AUC 0.94/0.87). Gap: radiomics-DL, small cohorts.

**5.4 ESCC neoadjuvant** — Niu et al., npj Precision Oncology 2025.

**5.5 RADAR CARE** — JCO Precision Oncology 2025. NSCLC recurrence multimodal transformer; baseline AUC 0.82, longitudinal 0.77, combined 0.85.

**5.6 HCC recurrence from baseline MRI** — Sci Rep 2023, VGG16+XGBoost.

---

## 6. Longitudinal Image Synthesis / Forecasting

**6.1 SADM** — Jee Seok Yoon, IPMI 2023, arXiv:2212.08228. Diffusion + sequence-aware transformer; handles missing frames; autoregressive. Cardiac + brain MRI.

**6.2 Forecasting Future Anatomies** — arXiv:2511.02558 (Nov 2025). Five archs (UNet, U²-Net, UNETR, Time-Embedding UNet, ODE-UNet) predict full future brain MRI from baseline; ADNI/AIBL.

**6.3 TimeFlow** — Bailiang Jian, D. Rueckert, C. Wachinger, arXiv:2501.08667 (IEEE TPAMI 2025). U-Net with temporal conditioning; continuous-function-of-age; inter/extrapolation consistency.

**6.4 Temporal Flow Matching (TFM)** — Nico Albert Disch, MIC-DKFZ, arXiv:2508.21580. Unified generative trajectory; 3D, multiple priors, irregular sampling; falls back to nearest-image predictor. Benchmarks ACDC, LUMIERE, ISLES. Code: github.com/MIC-DKFZ/Temporal-Flow-Matching.

**6.5 Latent Flow Matching for Longitudinal Imaging** — Hao Chen, ICLR 2026, arXiv:2512.09185. ArcRank Loss latent + FM on disease-specific time scale T; Δ-RMAE metric.

**6.6 Conditional Latent Diffusion (CLDM)** — Mouadden, Christodoulidis, Vakalopoulou, MICCAI 2025 paper 2656. Universal 2D/3D encoder + temporal transformer + cond LDM. Predicts ILD progression in systemic sclerosis + report gen.

**6.7 ImageFlowNet** — ICASSP 2025 Oral, Krishnaswamy lab, arXiv:2406.14794. Multiscale joint patient-time latent + Neural ODE/SDE flow field. Retinal GA, MS, GBM.

**6.8 Conditional Neural ODE for PD** — arXiv:2511.04789.

**6.9 Temporal Atlas-Guided Generation via Geometric Latent** — MICCAI 2025 paper 1050.

**6.10 Conditional Diffusion + Ordinal Regression** — OpenReview 9UGfOJBuL8.

**6.11 BrLP** (§4.6).

---

## 7. Continuous-Time Embeddings / Position Encoding for Irregular Intervals

**7.1 Time2Vec** — Kazemi 2019, arXiv:1907.05321. Learnable ω, φ sine + linear time embedding.

**7.2 Sinusoidal / Fourier** — CRONOS uses Fourier features for flow-step + clock-time. "Continuous-Time Linear Positional Embedding for Irregular Time Series Forecasting" arXiv:2409.20092.

**7.3 Δt-aware attention** — TaViT (§3a.4); "Time-Aware Attention for EHR" arXiv:2507.14847; "Time-to-Event Transformer" arXiv:2602.10385.

**7.4 Neural ODE for medical sequence** — ImageFlowNet, CNODE, BrLP aux. Review: Artif Intell Rev 2024 (s10462-024-10894-0).

**7.5 Time-aware MAE** — L-MAE (§3b.4); 3D MAE+spatiotemporal transformer for 4D fMRI (PubMed 41197226).

**7.6 Temporal RoPE** — "Learning to Rotate" arXiv:2604.24717.

---

## 8. Cross-modal Temporal Models (image + text + EHR + time)

**8.1 BioViL-T** (§1.18).
**8.2 TAMME** (§3b.6).
**8.3 IRENE** — Hong-Yu Zhou, Nat Biomed Eng 2023. Unified transformer for image+text+structured with bidirectional cross-modal attention. Gap: single-timepoint.
**8.4 ETHOS** — npj DM 2024, arXiv:2407.21124. Tokenized Patient Health Timelines; zero-shot event prediction. EHR-only.
**8.5 Foresight** — Lancet Digital Health 2024, arXiv:2212.08072. GPT-2-based EHR timeline. EHR-only.
**8.6 CoMET** — Epic/Microsoft 2025, arXiv:2508.12104. Decoder-only ≤1B params on 118M patients / 115B events. Power-law scaling for medical-event FMs. EHR-only.
**8.7 MAIRA-2** — Microsoft, arXiv:2406.04449. Grounded report gen with frontal+lateral+prior frontal+prior report+Indication/Technique/Comparison. CXR pair only.
**8.8 Longitudinal CXR report-gen** — HERGen (MICCAI 2024), MLRG (CVPR 2025, arXiv:2502.20056). Survey: arXiv:2510.12444.

---

## 9. Benchmarks / Eval Datasets

**9.1 3D-RAD** — arXiv:2506.11147, NeurIPS 2025. 170K Q-A entries, 6 VQA tasks including longitudinal/static temporal diagnosis. 18+ diseases. Existing VLMs fail on multi-temporal → key benchmark for Direction A.
**9.2 TADPOLE** (§4.1).
**9.3 INSPECT** — NeurIPS 2023 D&B, arXiv:2311.10798, Stanford Shah lab. 19,402 patients / 23,248 CTs + reports + longitudinal EHR; **first to link longitudinal EHR + 3D CT + reports**.
**9.4 NLST** — 26,254 LDCT patients, 3 screening rounds (T0/T1/T2), ~75K exams. NLSTseg adds pixel masks (Sci Data 2025).
**9.5 BraTS-Reg / BraTS 2024 / 2025 Lighthouse** — Baheti arXiv:2112.06979; longitudinal glioma; post-treatment cohort added 2024.
**9.6 HECKTOR 2020–25** — Andrearczyk, Depeursinge. FDG-PET/CT seg + RFS prediction; >1200 patients / 11 centers; best PFS C-index ~0.72.
**9.7 ADNI / OASIS / AIBL** — Brain longitudinal trilogy.
**9.8 ProstateX-AS** — MambaX-Net.
**9.9 LUMIERE / ISLES** — TFM benchmark.
**9.10 Longitudinal-MIMIC** — 26,625 patients multi-visit CXR + reports.
**9.11 OPHDIAT / AREDS** — L-MAE / 3DTINC / LONGL-Net.
**9.12 Epic Cosmos** — 300M-patient EHR scale.

---

## 10. White Space Analysis

**10.1 Architecture choices not tried**
- 3D-volume encoder + Δt-aware temporal attention in one FM trained on real inter-visit intervals (CRONOS is a forecaster; SSL-AD is brain-only small-scale).
- Per-visit cross-attention between 3D image tokens and EHR-event tokens with shared continuous-time PE (Merlin does single-time joint; nobody fuses 3D-image-sequence + EHR-sequence under one time axis).
- Mixed-modality sequences (CT@t1, MRI@t2, report@t3, lab@t4) under one tokenization (closest: CLDM, generative only).

**10.2 Objective combinations not tried**
- **Interval-aware Masked Volume Modeling (IA-MVM)**: masking ratio modulated by Δt — short Δt = high redundancy = aggressive masking; long Δt = mask conservatively, predict deltas. L-MAE prototypes this in 2D fundus only.
- **Next-volume prediction in latent space** as primary autoregressive SSL objective. CRONOS / Latent FM frame this as forecasting; nobody uses it as the *primary* pretraining objective for a representation FM.
- **Cross-modal temporal contrast**: match volume@t with report/EHR-window around t, push apart same-patient at t' ≠ t. Closest: ChronoCon (2D) / Temporal-SCL (tabular).
- **Trajectory-aligned contrast across patients**: LNE-style neighborhood embedding at FM scale across diseases.

**10.3 Clinical evaluations missing**
- RECIST prediction from ≥3 prior CTs with interval awareness + zero-shot.
- Cross-disease, cross-modality progression benchmarks (3D-RAD leaderboard).
- Time-to-event Harrell's C across ≥5 organ systems from one 3D temporal FM checkpoint.
- Longitudinal report-gen with prior-image + prior-report for non-CXR 3D modalities.

**10.4 Data regimes not tried**
- Unified pretraining on NLST + INSPECT + AbdomenAtlas-longitudinal + ADNI/OASIS + UK Biobank repeat-imaging.
- Re-tokenize Stanford PACS (used by Merlin/TTE) as 3D image sequences.
- Federated longitudinal pretraining across institutions.

---

## 11. Direct competitors — top 8

1. **TTE Pretraining (Stanford 2024, arXiv:2411.09361)** — same goal, but input is single CT with temporal labels. Direction A flips this.
2. **SSL-AD (arXiv:2509.10453)** — actual 3D temporal SSL on brain MRI sequences. Narrow but in-domain template.
3. **CRONOS (arXiv:2512.16577)** — multi-input continuous-time 4D forecasting; provides continuous-time recipe.
4. **Temporal Flow Matching (arXiv:2508.21580, MIC-DKFZ)** — sibling generative 3D trajectory.
5. **Merlin (arXiv:2406.06512)** — single-CT 3D VLM with longitudinal EHR-label supervision.
6. **BrLP (arXiv:2502.08560)** — 3D brain MRI latent-diffusion progression.
7. **TAMME / Holistic Time-Aware (MICCAI 2025)** — multimodal time-aware transformer with explicit Δt; lacks native 3D image encoder.
8. **BioViL-T / MAIRA-2** — 2D-CXR longitudinal-VLM SOTA; methodological reference.

**Next 5:** L-MAE, ImageFlowNet, HERGen/MLRG, CT-CLIP/CT-RATE, 3D-RAD.

---

## 12. Methodological Building Blocks Ready to Use

**12.1 Public code/checkpoints.** Merlin (StanfordMIMI), CT-FM, CT-CLIP/CT-RATE, 3DINO (AICONSlab), Triad/VISTA3D/SuPreM/VoCo/BrainIAC/Decipher-MR (all open), Sybil (reginabarzilaygroup), SADM (ubc-tea), Temporal Flow Matching (MIC-DKFZ), ImageFlowNet (KrishnaswamyLab), LNE (ouyangjiahong), 3D-RAD (Tang-xiaoxiao), BioViL-T + MAIRA-2 (Microsoft on HF).

**12.2 Temporal recipes to compose.** Fourier continuous-time PE (CRONOS); Δt-scaled attention (TaViT); time-aware PE for MAE (L-MAE); time-aware multimodal tokenization (TAMME); sequence-aware diffusion conditioning (SADM); trajectory-aligned neighborhood loss (LNE); TTE prediction loss (Huo); PHT-style EHR tokenizer (ETHOS/Foresight/CoMET).

**12.3 Evaluation benchmarks ready.** RECIST 1.1 (Cancers 2025 baselines); INSPECT; 3D-RAD multi-temporal subset; ADNI MCI-conversion 1/2/3-yr; NLST 1–6 yr (Sybil baseline + multi-screen input); HECKTOR PFS C-index; BraTS-Reg / 2024 post-treatment; TADPOLE 5-yr forecast; OPHDIAT / AREDS (control 2D modalities).

**12.4 Likely loss combo for Direction A**
- α · IA-MVM (interval-aware masked volume modeling, reconstruction)
- + β · NVP-LS (next-volume prediction in latent space, MSE or flow matching)
- + γ · CMTC (cross-modal temporal contrast: align volume(t) with text/EHR window around t; push apart same patient at t')
- + δ · TTE head (Huo-style; only needs longitudinal labels at fine-tune)
- + ε · Trajectory-manifold loss (LNE-style)

Encoder: 3D-ViT or U-Net-ViT-hybrid à la M3T/CT-ViT/SwinUNETR, with Fourier(Δt) added to patch tokens + Δt-scaled cross-visit attention.

---

1. **最强直接竞品：TTE Pretraining（Stanford）** —— single-CT 输入 + temporal labels；Direction A 把这个翻转过来

4. **最大 white space**：FM-scale + 多器官 + 3D 序列 + (a) interval-aware MVM + (b) next-volume prediction + (c) cross-modal temporal contrast —— **没人 ship 过**
5. **最佳评测目标**：3D-RAD (NeurIPS 2025)、INSPECT、NLST 1–6yr（beat Sybil）、TADPOLE、HECKTOR PFS、BraTS 2024 post-treatment、RECIST
6. **可直接 build on**：Merlin / CT-FM / CT-CLIP / 3DINO / Triad / Decipher-MR 开源权重 + Fourier-time (CRONOS) + Δt-attention (TaViT) + time-aware MAE (L-MAE) + TAMME tokenizer + TTE loss + PHT tokenizer

- 公开数据聚合上限：**~80–120k 病人有 ≥2 3D scan，~30–50k 有 ≥3 timepoint**

- 唯一独占 CT+EHR+reports+outcomes 配对：**INSPECT (Stanford)** 19k 病人

input.content:
# Stage 1A 中文简版：ML 顶会 trending

> 长版 [stage1a-ml-venues.md](stage1a-ml-venues.md)（~85 篇）。本文只挑出最影响 Direction A 决策的 paper + cluster 模式。

## A. 通用 FM 的几个最响 cluster（2024-26）

### A1. 推理模型（o1 时代）
- **OpenAI o1** (2024.09) — 开启整个范式
- **DeepSeek-R1** (Nature 2025) — GRPO 让 RL 推理民主化，**引用 1000+**
- **Scaling Test-Time Compute** (ICLR 2025 Oral) — 小模型 + TTC > 14× 大模型
- **s1 / LIMO** — 极少样本 (1K / 817) 复现 o1 级表现，证明 reasoning 主要靠 SFT 数据质量

→ **趋势：把"训更大模型"换成"训会想得更久的模型"**

### A2. VLM 开源追赶
- **Qwen2.5-VL** / **InternVL3.5** / **LLaVA-OneVision-1.5** / **Molmo** / **Pixtral** — 全 2024 后半到 2025，达到 GPT-4o 级
- **VGGT** — **CVPR 2025 Best Paper**，3D geometry 单次前向

→ **VLM 开源已追平 GPT-4o**，medical 的劣势变小

### A3. 架构：DeepSeek 一家独大 + 新尝试
- **DeepSeek-V3** (2024.12) — 671B MoE / 37B active；引用 1000+
- **Mixtral 8x22B** — 开 MoE 时代
- **Llama 4 Scout / Maverick** — Meta 转向 MoE
- **Gated Attention** — **NeurIPS 2025 Best Paper**，部署在 Qwen3
- **Memory Layers** (Meta, 2024.12) — 引用低（前面已弃）

→ **MoE 成主流；其他架构 (Mamba / SSM / Memory Layer) 信号弱**

### A4. 解释性（与 K 方向相关）
- **Scaling Monosemanticity** (Anthropic 2024.05) — Golden Gate Claude
- **Gemma Scope** (DeepMind) — 开源 SAE 库
- **SAE Survey** (2503.05613) — 综述
- **Alignment Faking** (Anthropic 2024.12) — viral

# Stage 1B 中文简版：医学顶刊 trending

> 长版 [stage1b-medical-venues.md](stage1b-medical-venues.md)（~95 篇）。只挑出影响 Direction A 决策的关键 paper + cluster 模式。

## C. Nat Med / NEJM AI / Lancet DH / Nat BME 几个最响 cluster

### C1. 临床部署 RCT 大规模 paper（2025-26 的真主菜）
- **AI Mammography RCT** (Nat Med 2025)：463k 妇女、12 中心，**+17.6% 检出**
- **AI Triage 非劣势试验** (Nat Med 2026)：**63.6% 工作量降低 + 15.2% 检出**
- **ScreenTrustMRI** (Nat Med 2024)：补充 MRI RCT
- **GPT-4 RCT** (Nat Med 2024)：92 医生，+6.5% 推理质量
- **Automation Bias RCT** (NEJM AI 2025)：受 AI 文化训练的医生 **-14%** 准确度（警告）
- **LLM 给普通人用** (Nat Med 2025)：用户 + LLM 只识 34.5% vs 单独 94.9%（**警告**）

→ **趋势：临床 RCT > 算法 paper**。但 Direction A 是基础 FM，不是 RCT，**走 NeurIPS/MICCAI 主线**

### C2. Tier-1 期刊上的 FM (2024-2026)
**最响的 FM paper（按时间倒序）：**

| FM | 期刊 | 数据规模 |
|---|---|---|
| **PanDerm** | Nat Med 2025 | 2M derm images |
| **TITAN** | Nat Med 2025 | 335,645 WSIs（pathology FM）|
| **EchoPrime** | Nature 2025 | 12M echo video-report 对 |
| **AMIE** | Nature 2025 | Differential dx（Google）|
| **ECGFounder** | NEJM AI 2025 | 10.77M ECG |
| **Med-LLM Diagnostic Reasoning** | Nat Med 2025 | 176B params |
| **BUSGen** | Nat BME 2026 | 3.5M 乳腺 US |
| **CT-CLIP / CT-CHAT** | **Nat BME 2025** | **25,692 胸 CT + 报告** |
| **FM-HCT** | Nat BME 2026 | **361,663 头 CT** |
| **Prima** | Nat BME 2025 | 220,000 MRI（neuro）|
| **Merlin** | **Nature 2026 (forthcoming)** | 15,331 CT + EHR |
| **MedSegX** | Nat BME 2025 | open-world seg FM |
| **HONeYBEE** | npj DM 2025 | 多模态肿瘤学 |
| **MIRAGE** | npj DM 2025 | OCT FM |
| **Decipher-MR** | npj DM 2026 | 3D MRI VLM, 200k series |
| **Global RETFound** | Nat Med 2025 | 100M 眼影像 65 国 |
| **PathOrchestra** | npj DM 2025 | 287k slides, 100+ tasks |

→ **每个亚专科都有自家 FM**。**3D CT 已有 Merlin/CT-CLIP/FM-HCT；3D MRI 有 Prima/Decipher-MR/Triad；但都是 single-timepoint**

### C3. 安全 / 监管 / 评测（与 AA 方向相关）
- **Limits of Fair Medical AI** (Nat Med 2024, Ghassemi MIT)
- **FM 是 Social Experiment** (npj DM 2025)
- **FDA SaMD 草案** + **Aidoc 腹部 CT FM clearance** (2026.01)
- **What Does It Mean for Medical AI to Be Right?** (2605.11963)
- **Generative AI in Medicine — Progress and Challenges** (NEJM Sounding Board 2025)

→ **AA 方向（hallucination gate）的 industry 信号在持续强化**

### C4. 评测论文 / 工具
- **CARES** (NeurIPS 2024) - trustworthiness
- **FairMedFM** (NeurIPS 2024) - fairness
- **MedVH** (2407.02730) - hallucination probes
- **GMAI-MMBench** (NeurIPS 2024 D&B) - 284 datasets / 38 modalities — GPT-4o 仅 53.96%

## D. 医学影像 tech 期刊 (MIA / IEEE TMI / npj Imaging)

### D1. 3D imaging FM 时代到了
- **Merlin** (Nature 2026)
- **CT-FM** (148k CTs, Harvard 2025)
- **VISTA3D** (CVPR 2025, NVIDIA)
- **Triad** (131,170 3D MRI)
- **MedDINOv3** (CT-3M, 3.87M slices)
- **3DINO-ViT** (npj DM 2025)
- **FM-Guided Multi-View Semi-Supervised Liver CT Seg** (npj DM 2025)

→ **3D CT/MRI FM 已成主流**。Direction A 的"3D FM" 不是 novelty——novelty 在"longitudinal"

### D2. Robustness / 部署 gap（信号有但不大）
- **MedSegX**: 开放世界分割 FM
- **CheXzero vs RAD-DINO 鲁棒性** — **RAD-DINO 最稳，CheXzero 部署崩溃**
- **The Architectural Gap in Clinical AI** (Lancet DH 2026)
- **Bias of FMs in Mammography** (MICCAI 2025)

## E. MICCAI 2024 / 2025

### Best papers
- **2025**: Fit Pixels Get Labels (meta-learning), Wave Inversion, R-Super (reports → seg)
- **2024**: RoCoSDF (3D US), ORacle (OR domain)

### FM track
- **M4oE** (MICCAI 2024): MoE for medical multimodal seg
- **MedCLIP-SAM / DeSAM / SAM-Med3D-MoE**
- **FDAS** (MICCAI 2025): FM distillation + anatomy-aware
- **Curriculum Prompting FMs**

→ **MICCAI 主流：SAM 衍生 / FM 适应 / 分割创新**。Direction A 完全没人占

### 手术 FM 新兴
- **SurgVLM** / **Surg-3M** / **EndoARSS** — 全是 2025
→ **跨域参考；可借鉴 video / 时间序列模式**

## F. medRxiv / arXiv 关键 preprint

- **AI Healthcare 2025 Year in Review** — multimodal FM **YoY 增长 25→144 篇**
- **LLM Pipeline Beats Physicians in CV Risk** — 真临床场景
- **GMAI-MMBench** — 综合评测
- **Adaptation of FMs Review** (2511.01284)
- **Pathology FM 相似性分析** — UNI2/Virchow2 最不同，Prov-GigaPath 平均最像

## 综合判断（给 Direction A）

**支持 A 的信号：**
1. **3D FM 已成主流但全 single-timepoint** —— 时间维度是真空白
2. **Aidoc 腹部 CT FM clearance** 表明工业界对 3D CT FM 有 deployment pull
3. **Merlin / CT-CLIP 上 Nature/Nat BME** 说明顶刊欢迎 3D CT FM
4. **m1 / Med-R1** 显示 reasoning 子方向已被占——A 主打 representation 而非 reasoning
5. **2025 multimodal FM 出版量 +475% YoY** —— 不是过气热点，是仍在上升

**反对 A 的信号：**
1. **每个亚专科已有 FM**——cross-专科 FM 难写出 narrative
2. **临床 RCT 比基础 FM 更受顶刊欢迎** —— 我们 paper 走 ML 顶会，不是 Nat Med
3. **Aerts / Mahmood / Stanford 等大组都在做**——竞争激烈

**没人发的（结合 Stage 1A 的白点）：**
- 3D FM × longitudinal × outcome（治疗反应、复发预测）
- 3D FM × patient-level multimodal（HONeYBEE 是 pathology + omics，不含 3D radiology）
- 3D medical reasoning RL with imaging verifier

# Direction A 文献综述 · 中文简版

> 长版 [lit-review.md](lit-review.md)（~75 篇，英文，12 sections）。本文只保留关键判断。

## 一句话定位
**Direction A = 第一个 native 吃多个 3D timepoint 的 medical FM**。其他人要么是 single-timepoint，要么是 2-timepoint pair，要么是非 FM 的 forecaster。

---

## 直接竞品 8 强（按威胁度排）

| # | 作品 | 输入 | 弱点 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | **TTE Pretraining**（Stanford, arXiv 2411.09361）| 单 CT | label 时序，影像不是序列 |
| 2 | SSL-AD (2509.10453) | 3D 序列 | 仅脑 MRI，3,161 病人，小 |

| 5 | **Merlin** (Nature 2026, Stanford) | 单 CT + EHR + reports | 5-yr risk 用 EHR label 的时序，影像静态 |
| 6 | BrLP (2502.08560) | 3D 序列 | 仅脑 MRI 生成 |
| 7 | TAMME / Holistic Time-Aware (MICCAI 2025) | 多模态序列 | 没 native 3D image 编码器 |

| 领域 | 成熟度 | 代表 |
|---|---|---|
| Single-timepoint 3D FM | **饱和** | Merlin, CT-CLIP, CT-FM, RadFM, M3FM, 3DINO, Triad, Decipher-MR |
| 单图 + EHR label 时序 | **被 TTE 占** | Stanford TTE Pretraining |
| 2D 纵向 SSL | 成熟（CXR 居多）| BioViL-T, MAIRA-2, L-MAE |
| 3D 纵向 SSL | **几乎零（关键缺口）** | SSL-AD（脑 only / 小）|
| 3D 纵向生成 | 升温中 | BrLP, SADM, TFM, Latent FM |

### 架构层
- 3D-volume encoder + Δt-aware temporal attention 在一个 **FM 而不是 forecaster** 里（CRONOS 是 forecaster；SSL-AD 是脑专用小规模）
- 3D image tokens × EHR event tokens × shared continuous-time PE 的 **per-visit cross-attention**（Merlin 单 timepoint；没人合 3D image 序列 + EHR 序列在同一时间轴）
- 混合模态序列（CT@t1, MRI@t2, report@t3, lab@t4）统一 tokenization（最近的 CLDM 仅 generative）

### Objective 层
- **Interval-aware Masked Volume Modeling (IA-MVM)**: 短 Δt 高冗余高 mask 比率；长 Δt 保守 mask 预测 delta。L-MAE 在 2D fundus 做了；3D zero
- **Next-volume prediction in latent space** 作 SSL 的 primary objective（CRONOS / Latent FM 框成 forecasting，没人用作 representation 预训练 primary）
- **Cross-modal temporal contrast**: volume@t 与 report/EHR window 配对，push same-patient t' ≠ t 远离（ChronoCon 是 2D；Temporal-SCL 是 tabular）
- **Trajectory-aligned contrast across patients**（LNE 的 FM-scale 版）

### 临床评测
- **RECIST 预测**从 ≥3 prior CT + interval awareness + zero-shot —— 没人做
- 跨疾病、跨模态 progression benchmark（3D-RAD 是基础）
- Time-to-event Harrell's C 跨 ≥5 器官系统从一个 3D temporal FM checkpoint
- 非-CXR 3D 模态的纵向报告生成

### 数据层
- **没人**统一用 NLST + INSPECT + AbdomenAtlas-longitudinal + ADNI/OASIS + UK Biobank repeat 预训练
- Federated longitudinal cross-institution
- 重 tokenize Stanford PACS 为 3D image 序列

---

## 可直接借用的 building blocks（开源 / 现成）

### Pretrained 权重
Merlin · CT-FM · CT-CLIP / CT-RATE · 3DINO · Triad · VISTA3D · SuPreM · VoCo · BrainIAC · Decipher-MR · Sybil · SADM · Temporal Flow Matching (MIC-DKFZ) · ImageFlowNet · LNE · 3D-RAD · BioViL-T · MAIRA-2（全部 HF / GitHub 公开）

### 时序 recipe
| 来源 | 借用什么 |
|---|---|
| **CRONOS** | Fourier continuous-time PE |
| **TaViT** | Δt-scaled attention |
| **L-MAE** | time-aware PE for MAE |
| **TAMME** | time-aware multimodal tokenization |
| **SADM** | sequence-aware diffusion conditioning |
| **LNE** | trajectory-aligned neighborhood loss |
| **TTE (Huo)** | survival head 损失 |
| **ETHOS / Foresight / CoMET** | PHT-style EHR tokenizer |

### 评测 benchmark（ready to use）
- **RECIST 1.1** (Cancers 2025 baselines)
- **INSPECT** (Stanford, 19k CT + 5-yr EHR)
- **3D-RAD multi-temporal** (NeurIPS 2025)
- **ADNI MCI conversion** 1/2/3-yr
- **NLST 1–6 yr** (Sybil baseline + 多 screen 输入)
- **HECKTOR PFS C-index**
- **BraTS 2024 post-treatment**
- **TADPOLE 5-yr forecast**

---

## 推荐 loss 组合（lit review agent 的建议）

```
total = α · IA-MVM           # interval-aware masked volume reconstruction
      + β · NVP-LS           # next-volume prediction in latent space (MSE or flow matching)
      + γ · CMTC             # cross-modal temporal contrast (volume(t) ↔ text/EHR window)
      + δ · TTE-head         # Huo-style survival on longitudinal labels (fine-tune only)
      + ε · trajectory-loss  # LNE-style manifold
```

**Encoder**：3D-ViT 或 U-Net-ViT-hybrid（参考 M3T / CT-ViT / SwinUNETR），加 Fourier(Δt) 到 patch token + Δt-scaled cross-visit attention

---

## 一句话给 Direction A 的最终判断

> **空间是真的存在的，前 5 强竞品有 4 个公开权重 + 1 个被 Stanford 占着但他们走的是"单图 + 时序 label"那条路，刚好留出"序列 + label"那块。最大的不是 novelty 问题而是 (1) 工程 (2) 拿到足够的多-timepoint 数据。**

# 公开纵向数据集 · 中文简版

> 长版 [datasets.md](datasets.md)（~70 数据集）。本文只保留实际能用于 Direction A 的核心 dataset。
> **CT 数据集的深度调研（含链接、引用、精确数字）**：见 [datasets-deep.md](datasets-deep.md)（subagent 跑完后填）

## 关键数字（聚合上限）

- **~80–120k 病人**有 ≥2 个 3D scan
- **~30–50k 病人**有 ≥3 timepoint
- **~20–30k 病人**有丰富配对 label（reports / EHR / outcomes）

## 最重要的 10 个数据集（按对 Direction A 的实用度）

| # | 数据集 | 病人数 | TP | 模态 | 配对 | 评级 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **NLST** | 26,722 LDCT 臂 | 3 (T0/T1/T2) | LDCT | 死亡率 / 癌症 dx / 吸烟史 | ★★★★★ |
| 2 | **UK Biobank repeat imaging** | ~20k 2nd visit | 2 | 脑/心/腹 MRI | 全 EHR + 基因 + 实验室 | ★★★★★（要钱）|
| 3 | **ABCD Study** | ~11,800 | ≤ 4 | 脑 sMRI/dMRI/fMRI | 认知 / 心理 / omics | ★★★★（青少年）|
| 4 | **INSPECT** (Stanford) | 19,438 | 多为 1 CT | CTPA + 5-yr EHR + reports | PE dx / mortality / recurrence | ★★★★（评测金标准）|
| 5 | **ADNI 1/2/3/4** | ~3,500+ | 2–10+ | 脑 MRI + PET | CSF / blood / 基因 / 认知 | ★★★★★（AD 标准）|
| 6 | **COPDGene** | 10,300 | 2 (Phase1+2) | 吸气 + 呼气 CT | 肺功能 / mortality | ★★★★ |
| 7 | **CT-RATE** | 21,304（~3-4k ≥2 TP）| 多为 1 | 胸 CT + reports | 多标签 abnormality | ★★★★（**开源**）|
| 8 | **NELSON** | 13,195 | 4 | 体素 LDCT | 10/11 yr mortality | ★★★★ |
| 9 | **NACC SCAN** | 54k+ | 多 | 脑 sMRI + PET | UDS / biospec / neuropath | ★★★★（多中心）|
| 10 | **MIMIC-CXR longi** | 26,625 多次访问 | 多 | **2D** CXR + reports + MIMIC-IV EHR | dx codes | ★★★（2D fallback）|

## 治疗反应专用（最小但 label 最强）

| 数据集 | 病人数 | TP | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **ISPY1 + ISPY2** | 222 + 985 | 4 (NAC) | 乳腺 NAC pCR/EFS（DCE-MRI）|
| **UPenn-GBM** | 630 | baseline + 2nd surgery 部分 | GBM RANO + 基因 |
| **LUMIERE** | 91 | 平均 ~7 TP | GBM 高密度纵向 MRI |
| **MU-Glioma-Post** | 100+ | 多 TP | post-treatment GBM |
| **UCSD-PTGBM** | 298 | 多 | post-treatment GBM (2025) |
| **Yale-Brain-Mets-Longitudinal** | 1,430 | mean 8 | 脑转移 + clinical sub |
| **NSCLC-Cetuximab (RTOG 0617)** | 490 | 多 | NSCLC + OS |
| **ACRIN-6668** | 226 | pre + post chemo | NSCLC + PET-CT + RECIST |
| **HCC-TACE-Seg** | 105 | pre + post TACE | HCC + response |
| **CRLM-CT** | 197 | pre + post chemo | 结直肠肝转移 |
| **HEAD-NECK-Cetuximab** | 111 | pre + post RT | OPC + 试验 outcomes |
| **OPC-Radiomics** | 606 | baseline + on-RT CBCT | RFS/OS |
| **HECKTOR 2025** | 882 | follow-up 部分 | PET-CT + OPC outcomes |
| **HNTSMRG24** | 150 | pre + mid-RT | MRI-guided adaptive RT |

## 数据野心 tier 建议

### Tier 1（5k 病人 ≥3 timepoint）—— 6 周可达
- ADNI ~3k + OASIS-2/3 ~1.5k + AIBL ~2k + PPMI ~1.5k = **~8k 脑 MRI**
- 或单 NLST = 26k × 3 TP（**仅胸 CT**）

### Tier 2（20k 病人 ≥3 timepoint）—— 3–6 个月可达
- UK Biobank repeat (~20k × 2) + ADNI/AIBL/OASIS-3/PPMI/NACC/Rotterdam ≥3 TP layer 加起来 ~30k
- 但 UK Biobank repeat 只 **2 TP**

### Tier 3（50k 病人 ≥2 CT）—— **理论上限**
- NLST (~26k × 3) + NELSON (~7.9k × 4) + COPDGene (~10k × 2) + MESA-Lung (~3k × 2) + SPIROMICS (~3k) = **~50k**
- 加 CT-RATE longi + TCIA NSCLC trial cohorts 多 ~3–5k

## 多模态配对（image + reports + EHR）独占

- **INSPECT**：最佳 CT + EHR + reports + outcomes
- **UK Biobank**：image + genomics + dense EHR（**付费 DUA**）
- **CT-RATE**：开源 license + reports
- **MIMIC-CXR + MIMIC-IV**：**2D X-ray** + EHR longi
- **NACC SCAN**：多 ADRC 协调 imaging + UDS + neuropath

## 重要 caveat

1. **License redistribution**：UK Biobank / NLST / NACC / NDA **不能再分发数据**（model weight 通常可以）
2. **TCIA 多 CC-BY** 可再分发
3. **DUA 等待时间**：ADNI/PPMI/OASIS 几天；UK Biobank 8–16 周 + 付费；NLST/PLCO/COPDGene/MESA 4–12 周；NACC-SCAN 几周
4. **Pediatric**（ABCD/HBCD/dHCP/IBIS）需 IRB 级别控制
5. **去重**：BraTS 与 UPenn-GBM/UCSF-PDGM/MU-Glioma-Post 等有重叠
6. **Dropout bias**：纵向 cohort 病重的人更易 dropout，要处理 informative censoring

## Pretraining 联合策略（推荐）

按优先级合并以下来源（去重后 ~80–120k 病人，~30–50k 有 ≥3 TP）：

1. NLST（胸 CT 锚点）
2. UK Biobank repeat（多器官 2 TP）
3. ABCD（脑 4 TP）
4. NACC-SCAN + ADRC raw
5. COPDGene + NELSON + SPIROMICS + MESA-Lung
6. ADNI + AIBL + OASIS + PPMI + 4RTNI + Cam-CAN + Rotterdam（脑 MRI）
7. CT-RATE（开源 license，用于 report 预训练）
8. MIMIC-CXR（2D fallback）
9. Yale-Brain-Mets + ISPY1/2 + UPenn-GBM + LUMIERE + Duke-Liver + NSCLC + HEAD-NECK（治疗反应评测）
10. HCP-D / HCP-A / dHCP / HBCD / IBIS（lifespan）

---

## 给 Direction A 的具体 datasets 推荐

| 阶段 | 用什么 |
|---|---|
| **预训练**（要规模）| NLST + UK Biobank + ABCD + NACC + COPDGene + ADNI + CT-RATE = ~60-80k 病人 |
| **多模态预训练** | INSPECT + CT-RATE + MIMIC-CXR + UK Biobank（要 DUA）|
| **fine-tune & 评测** | INSPECT（PE/mortality）+ NLST（lung cancer 1-6yr）+ ADNI（MCI conversion）+ TADPOLE + 3D-RAD + ISPY1/2（RECIST）+ Yale-Brain-Mets + LUMIERE |

- ADNI ~3k + OASIS-2/3 ~1.5k + AIBL ~2k + PPMI ~1.5k = **~8k 脑 MRI**
- 或单 NLST = 26k × 3 TP（**仅胸 CT**）

### Tier 2（20k 病人 ≥3 timepoint）—— 3–6 个月可达
- UK Biobank repeat (~20k × 2) + ADNI/AIBL/OASIS-3/PPMI/NACC/Rotterdam ≥3 TP layer 加起来 ~30k
- 但 UK Biobank repeat 只 **2 TP**

### Tier 3（50k 病人 ≥2 CT）—— **理论上限**
- NLST (~26k × 3) + NELSON (~7.9k × 4) + COPDGene (~10k × 2) + MESA-Lung (~3k × 2) + SPIROMICS (~3k) = **~50k**
- 加 CT-RATE longi + TCIA NSCLC trial cohorts 多 ~3–5k

## 多模态配对（image + reports + EHR）独占

- **INSPECT**：最佳 CT + EHR + reports + outcomes
- **UK Biobank**：image + genomics + dense EHR（**付费 DUA**）
- **CT-RATE**：开源 license + reports
- **MIMIC-CXR + MIMIC-IV**：**2D X-ray** + EHR longi
- **NACC SCAN**：多 ADRC 协调 imaging + UDS + neuropath

## 重要 caveat

1. **License redistribution**：UK Biobank / NLST / NACC / NDA **不能再分发数据**（model weight 通常可以）
2. **TCIA 多 CC-BY** 可再分发
3. **DUA 等待时间**：ADNI/PPMI/OASIS 几天；UK Biobank 8–16 周 + 付费；NLST/PLCO/COPDGene/MESA 4–12 周；NACC-SCAN 几周
4. **Pediatric**（ABCD/HBCD/dHCP/IBIS）需 IRB 级别控制
5. **去重**：BraTS 与 UPenn-GBM/UCSF-PDGM/MU-Glioma-Post 等有重叠
6. **Dropout bias**：纵向 cohort 病重的人更易 dropout，要处理 informative censoring

## Pretraining 联合策略（推荐）

按优先级合并以下来源（去重后 ~80–120k 病人，~30–50k 有 ≥3 TP）：

1. NLST（胸 CT 锚点）
2. UK Biobank repeat（多器官 2 TP）
3. ABCD（脑 4 TP）
4. NACC-SCAN + ADRC raw
5. COPDGene + NELSON + SPIROMICS + MESA-Lung
6. ADNI + AIBL + OASIS + PPMI + 4RTNI + Cam-CAN + Rotterdam（脑 MRI）
7. CT-RATE（开源 license，用于 report 预训练）
8. MIMIC-CXR（2D fallback）
9. Yale-Brain-Mets + ISPY1/2 + UPenn-GBM + LUMIERE + Duke-Liver + NSCLC + HEAD-NECK（治疗反应评测）
10. HCP-D / HCP-A / dHCP / HBCD / IBIS（lifespan）

---

## 给 Direction A 的具体 datasets 推荐

| 阶段 | 用什么 |
|---|---|
| **预训练**（要规模）| NLST + UK Biobank + ABCD + NACC + COPDGene + ADNI + CT-RATE = ~60-80k 病人 |
| **多模态预训练** | INSPECT + CT-RATE + MIMIC-CXR + UK Biobank（要 DUA）|
| **fine-tune & 评测** | INSPECT（PE/mortality）+ NLST（lung cancer 1-6yr）+ ADNI（MCI conversion）+ TADPOLE + 3D-RAD + ISPY1/2（RECIST）+ Yale-Brain-Mets + LUMIERE |

# 癌症治疗反应纵向 CT 数据集深度调研

调研日期: 2026-05-13 | 数据来源: TCIA collection 页面 / descriptor papers / 原始 RCT papers

---

## 1. NSCLC-Cetuximab / RTOG 0617

**基本信息**
- 全称: Data from NSCLC-Cetuximab (RTOG-0617)
- TCIA URL: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/nsclc-cetuximab/
- TCIA DOI/Descriptor: 10.7937/TCIA.2018.jze75u7v
- 原始 RCT: Bradley et al., *Lancet Oncol.* 2015 Feb;16(2):187-99 (NCT00533949)

**规模**
- 病人数: **490 subjects** (TCIA stats)
- 影像: 490 studies / 2,116 series / **75,063 images**
- 每位病人 CT 个数: **单 baseline timepoint**（"CT of chest within 6 weeks of registration"）

**时间结构**
- Baseline only (treatment-planning CT)，**不是纵向**
- 注: 原始 RCT 当然有随访，但 TCIA 上只放 baseline CT

**模态**
- Diagnostic/RT-planning CT + RTSTRUCT + RTPLAN + RTDOSE
- 无 PET / MR

**配对数据**
- RECIST: 未在 TCIA 上发布
- Survival labels: 通过外部 NCTN/NCORP Data Archive 获取（需另外申请）
- Molecular markers: 未在 TCIA 上发布
- 注释: RT structure sets (GTV/OAR)

**Access**
- **Restricted (NIH Controlled Data Access Policy)** — 此前 login-access download 已下架，等待新 controlled-access 实施
- 当前 **无法直接公开下载**
- 大小: **42.65 GB**

**License**: NIH Controlled Data Access (非 CC-BY，**不可自由 redistribute**)

**Caveats (直说)**
- **关键限制**: 只有 baseline 单 timepoint，**不能做"治疗前后变化"建模**
- 临床 outcomes 不在 TCIA 内
- 当前 access restricted，**对 paper 评测来说现状不友好**
- 适合用于 RT planning / GTV segmentation pretraining，不适合 RECIST/response prediction

**关键文献**
- Bradley JD et al., *Lancet Oncol* 2015, 16(2):187-99
- TCIA descriptor: 10.7937/TCIA.2018.jze75u7v

---

## 2. ACRIN-NSCLC-FDG-PET / ACRIN 6668 (RTOG 0235)

**基本信息**
- 全称: Data from the ACRIN 6668 Trial NSCLC-FDG-PET (Version 2)
- TCIA URL: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/acrin-nsclc-fdg-pet/
- TCIA Descriptor DOI: 10.7937/tcia.2019.30ilqfcl
- 原始 RCT: Machtay et al., *J Clin Oncol* 2013;31(30):3823-3830, https://doi.org/10.1200/JCO.2012.47.5947

**规模**
- 病人数: **242 enrolled**, 226 with evaluable pretreatment PET, **173 with evaluable post-treatment PET (primary analysis cohort)**
- 影像: 950 studies / 3,377 series / **497,367 images**
- 每位病人 scan: **2 timepoints** (baseline + ~14 周 post-RT)

**时间结构**
- T0: pretreatment baseline whole-body FDG-PET/CT
- T1: post-treatment ~14 weeks after RT (≥4 weeks after adjuvant chemo)
- 随访: minimum 2 years 或至死亡

**模态**
- **PET/CT** (PT + CT) + 一些 NM/MR/CR/DX/SC
- low-dose CT（非 diagnostic 质量）

**配对数据**
- RECIST: 未明确（用 SUV-based 评估）
- Survival labels: OS + 进展时间（"dates of progression and survival"）
- 标注: SUV ROI 测量、central review；MTV 可重新计算
- Treatment: stage III locally advanced NSCLC，concurrent chemoradiation

**Access**
- **Public**, CC BY 3.0
- 下载: TCIA Data Retriever / NBIA
- 大小: **145.5 GB**

**License**: CC BY 3.0 — **可 redistribute**

**Caveats**
- **真正治疗前后配对的少数 TCIA 数据集之一**
- 但 N=173 paired，**对 FM scale 而言偏小**
- CT 是 PET/CT 的 low-dose CT，**不是 diagnostic CT**，纹理特征受限
- 单一 NCTN 来源，但是 multi-site (ACRIN 网络)

**关键已用工作**
- Machtay 2013 原 trial paper
- 多篇 SUV-change radiomics paper 后续验证

---

## 3. S0819 (SWOG)

**基本信息**
- 全称: Carboplatin/Paclitaxel ± Bevacizumab ± Cetuximab in Advanced NSCLC (S0819)
- TCIA URL: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/s0819/
- Annotations: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/analysis-result/s0819-tumor-annotations/
- TCIA Descriptor DOI: 10.7937/DT39-JS04
- 原始 RCT: Herbst et al., *Lancet Oncol* 2018, https://doi.org/10.1016/S1470-2045(17)30694-0

**规模**
- 病人数 (imaging): **1,299 subjects** (TCIA); 原 trial 1,313 ITT
- 影像: 32,324 series / **3,558,078 images** — 这是 TCIA 上**最大的肺癌纵向 CT 数据集之一**
- Annotation cohort: **1,281 subjects** with annotations, 2,556 studies, 20,181 annotated series

**时间结构**
- **真正纵向**: baseline + progression follow-up（"Initial baseline imaging (pre-treatment), follow-up scans at disease progression, or alternative timepoints if no progression"）
- De-identified dates preserved，可以重构时序

**模态**
- CT + PT (PET) + MR + SC + NM
- 多机构、多扫描仪（multi-site SWOG）

**配对数据**
- **RECIST 1.1** (annotations explicitly say "RECIST 1.1 was generally followed; max 5 lesions/scan, ≤2 per organ")
- 注释: DICOM RTSTRUCT seed points + measurements + CSV metadata report
- Survival: OS, PFS 在外部 NCTN/NCORP Data Archive（不直接在 TCIA）
- Molecular markers: EGFR FISH/IHC（external paper）

**Access**
- **Imaging: Restricted (NIH Controlled Data Access)**, login removed, awaiting new policy
- **Annotations: Public, CC BY 4.0**, 596.65 MB (RTSTRUCT) + 10 MB CSV
- 大小: **1.82 TB** (imaging)

**License**: 影像 NIH Controlled; annotations CC BY 4.0

**Caveats (重要)**
- **最大、最全的 RECIST-annotated 纵向 NSCLC trial data**
- 但 **影像本身当前 restricted**，annotations 公开
- 若拿不到底层影像，对 FM 训练不够；annotation+metadata 可用于评测公平比较
- Linkage 到 clinical outcomes 需联系 NCTN/NCORP（额外 application）

**关键文献**
- Herbst et al., *Lancet Oncol* 2018
- Hirsch et al., *Clin Lung Cancer* 2022, PMC8766941（EGFR analysis）

## 11. HECKTOR (2022)

**基本信息**
- 注: **HECKTOR 不在 TCIA**，在 Grand Challenge platform
- URL: https://hecktor.grand-challenge.org/Data/
- Descriptor: Andrearczyk et al., *Lect Notes Comput Sci* 2023; PMC 10171217, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10171217/

**规模**
- 病人数: **883 cases total** = 524 training + 359 test
- 9 个 centers (Canada, Switzerland, France, USA)

**时间结构 / 是否纵向**
- **Cross-sectional, single timepoint** (initial staging PET/CT before RT)
- **不是纵向**；只是 baseline imaging + RFS outcome label

**模态**
- **FDG-PET + low-dose non-contrast CT** (from combined PET/CT scanners)
- 文件格式 NIfTI (.nii.gz), 已 SUV preprocessed

**配对数据**
- Segmentation: **GTVp (primary tumor) + GTVn (nodes)** — manually delineated
- **RFS (recurrence-free survival)** as primary outcome (Task 2)
- ~21% recurrence events, median RFS 14 months
- Clinical info: age, gender, weight, tobacco, alcohol, performance status, **HPV status**, treatment (RT alone vs RT+chemo/surgery)

**Access**
- **Public via challenge registration** (request approval)
- License: 未明确公开 CC（"dataset currently restricted pending hospital agreement extension"）
- 格式: NIfTI

**License**: 不确定 / restricted via challenge agreement — **不能 freely redistribute**

**Caveats**
- **PET+CT 配对**, 非纯 CT；CT 是 low-dose
- 不是纵向（虽然 RFS endpoint 是 follow-up 派生）
- License 不清晰，redistribution 有 risk
- 是 head/neck outcome prediction 最大公开 dataset 之一

---
